        static boolean isComparisonMessage(String value) {
            pdsync.i18n.UiText[] messages = {
                CoreMessages.CHECKING_SAVES, CoreMessages.THE_CHECK_IS_NOT_COMPLETE_PLEASE_RETRY,
                CoreMessages.NEITHER_SIDE_HAS_SAVES_CREATE_SOME_PROGRESS_IN_THE_GAME_FIRST,
                CoreMessages.THIS_DEVICE_HAS_SAVES_READY_TO_UPLOAD,
                CoreMessages.THE_CLOUD_HAS_SAVES_READY_TO_RESTORE_TO_THIS_DEVICE,
                CoreMessages.BOTH_SIDES_HAVE_THE_SAME_SAVES_CONFIRM_TO_CONTINUE,
                CoreMessages.THE_SAVES_DIFFER_CHOOSE_THE_PROGRESS_YOU_WANT_TO_CONTINUE,
                CoreMessages.THE_CLOUD_HAS_MULTIPLE_BRANCHES_OF_PROGRESS_CHOOSE_ONE,
                CoreMessages.CANNOT_COMPARE_RIGHT_NOW_RESOLVE_THE_ISSUE_AND_RETRY
            };
            for (pdsync.i18n.UiText message : messages)
                if (message.chinese().equals(value) || message.english().equals(value)) return true;
            return false;
        }
        static String feedback(String raw, String fallback) { return fallback; }

    boolean readyForSaves() { return bridgeReady && installedBridge != null; }
    void maybeActivateSetupComponent() { activationChecks++; }
    interface Task<T> { T run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done<T> { void accept(MainActivity owner, T value) throws Exception; }
    <T> void setupWork(DiagnosticAction action, String text, Task<T> work, Done<T> done) {
        if (busy || setupSession.running || destroyed) return;
        busy = setupSession.running = true;
        Runnable execute = () -> {
            try {
                T value = work.run(); busy = setupSession.running = false;
                if (action == DiagnosticAction.PREPARE && pauseAfterPrepare) resumed = false;
                done.accept(this, value);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                busy = setupSession.running = false; feedbackError = true;
                if (action == DiagnosticAction.PREPARE) setupSession.modeChoice.offer(setupSession.selectedSource);
            }
            drainExternalInstallation();
        };
        if (deferNextWork) { deferNextWork = false; deferredWork = execute; }
        else execute.run();
    }
    GamePreparationService.PreparedPair m58lambda$prepare$33$iogithubxyz1001pdsyncandroidMainActivity(List<Uri> list, String pkg, boolean consent) throws Exception {
        prepares++; processed = list; processedPackage = pkg;
        if (failPrepare) throw new IOException("broken APK");
        GamePreparationService.PreparedPair p = new GamePreparationService.PreparedPair(); p.gameStrategy = strategy;
        if (pkg != null) p.gamePackage = pkg;
        if (list != null) {
            p.gameApks = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < list.size(); index++) p.gameApks.add(new File(index == 0 ? "base.apk" : "split-" + index + ".apk"));
        }
        p.helperOnlyUpgrade = specialHelperInput;
        return p;
    }
    MainActivity getPackageManager() { return this; }

    void startActivityForResult(Intent i, int code) {
        if (code == EXTERNAL_INSTALL || (code >= 16000 && code <= 65534)) {
            require("android.intent.action.VIEW".equals(i.action), "Ordinary APK uses unwrapped ACTION_VIEW, preserving default installer");
            if (failChooser) throw new IllegalStateException("No external resolver");
            chooserLaunches++;
        } else settingsLaunches++;
    }
    void reportError(Exception error) { feedbackError = true; }
    void startIntentSenderForResult(Object sender, int code, Object intent, int a, int b, int c, Object options) {
        require("visible-only-options".equals(options), "Foreground options passed to platform launch");
        if (failLaunch) throw new IllegalStateException("launch failed");
        intentLaunches++;
    }
    void refreshReadiness() { readinessRefreshes++; }
    void confirm(String title, String message, String positive, Runnable action) { confirmation = action; confirmationText = message; }
    void finishDeferredWork() {
        Runnable work = deferredWork; deferredWork = null;
        require(work != null, "There is deferred source work"); work.run();
    }

    static void require(boolean value, String why) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(why); }
    static MainActivity selected() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        a.installedBridge = new InstalledBridgeBinding("previous.game"); // A previously bridged installed game must not substitute the selected file.
        a.setupSession.modeChoice.offer(GameModeChoice.Source.files(List.of(new Uri("content://chosen/base.apk"), new Uri("content://chosen/split.apk"))));
        a.renderDiscovery();
        return a;
    }
    static MainActivity selectedSingle() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.installedBridge = new InstalledBridgeBinding("previous.game");
        a.setupSession.modeChoice.offer(GameModeChoice.Source.files(List.of(new Uri("content://chosen/base.apk"))));
        a.renderDiscovery(); return a;
    }
    static MainActivity installed() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        a.setupSession.modeChoice.offer(GameModeChoice.Source.installed("installed.game"));
        a.renderDiscovery();
        return a;
    }
    static void verifyInstalledApkActions() {
        MainActivity a = installed();
        require(a.prepares == 0 && a.installedInspections == 0 && a.bridgeChecks == 0,
                "Selecting or rendering an installed source must be inert before a mode click");
        click(a);
        require(a.installedInspections == 1 && "installed.game".equals(a.inspectedPackage),
                "Installed APK card inspects the explicitly selected package");
        require(a.installer.sourceSelections == 1 && a.bridgeChecks == 1
                        && "installed.game".equals(a.resolvedPackage),
                "Installed APK card reaches the production bridge decision once");
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.processed == null && "installed.game".equals(a.processedPackage),
                "Installed APK card prepares the selected installed package immediately when bridge is absent");
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 1 && a.installer.externalPrepares == 1
                        && a.installer.installs == 0 && a.intentLaunches == 0 && a.confirmation == null,
                "Installed single APK directly opens the default ACTION_VIEW exactly once");
        click(a); a.renderDiscovery(); click(a); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.bridgeChecks == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "Rapid installed APK taps and rerender cannot repeat preparation or handoff");

        a.resumed = false; a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.resumed = true; a.systemReturnPending = true; a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1 && a.installer.externalChecks == 0,
                "Background and installer return do not replay or implicitly check external installation");
        int returnedRequestCode = a.installer.externalActivityRequestCode();
        a.externalInstallResult(returnedRequestCode, 0);
        require(a.installer.externalReturns == 1 && a.installer.externalChecks == 1
                        && a.installer.externalEnds == 0 && !a.installer.active && a.installer.observation,
                "Real canceled Activity result unlocks automatically without ending the external share");
        a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.resumed = false; a.drainPendingSetup(); a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "Canceled external installation stays canceled across rendering and resume");
        click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 2 && a.bridgeChecks == 2 && a.chooserLaunches == 2,
                "Only a new explicit installed APK click retries canceled installation");
        a.externalInstallResult(returnedRequestCode, 0);
        require(a.installer.active && a.installer.external && a.installer.externalReturns == 1,
                "A stale earlier Activity result cannot unlock the new explicit installation");

        a = installed(); a.deferNextWork = true; click(a);
        require(a.busy && a.setupSession.running && a.prepares == 0,
                "Installed source inspection may remain in flight");
        click(a); a.renderDiscovery(); click(a); a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.finishDeferredWork();
        require(a.installedInspections == 1 && a.bridgeChecks == 1 && a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "Rapid taps during installed source inspection dispatch only one work chain");

        a = installed(); a.bridgeAvailable = true; click(a);
        require(a.bridgeChecks == 1 && a.bridgeAuthentications == 1 && a.readyForSaves()
                        && "installed.game".equals(a.boundPackage),
                "An existing installed bridge is authenticated for the selected package");
        require(a.prepares == 0 && a.chooserLaunches == 0 && a.installer.installs == 0
                        && a.notice.equals("游戏组件已连接。"),
                "A valid installed bridge becomes ready without reinjection or installer launch");
        a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup(); a.resumed = false; a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.bridgeChecks == 1 && a.bridgeAuthentications == 1 && a.prepares == 0,
                "Ready bridge is not reauthenticated or reinjected by lifecycle rendering");

        a = installed(); a.bridgeAvailable = true; a.bridgeHandshakeRequired = true; click(a);
        require(a.bridgeAuthentications == 1 && a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "A bridge requiring a pure handshake follows the production preparation fallback");

        a = installed(); a.pauseAfterPrepare = true; click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 0 && a.setupSession.installationAdvancePending,
                "Installed source prepared in background defers the default installer");
        a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 0, "Background drain cannot launch installed APK UI");
        a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup(); a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1 && !a.setupSession.installationAdvancePending,
                "Foreground installed-source continuation hands off once without preparing again");

        a = installed(); a.failPrepare = true; click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 0
                        && a.setupSession.modeChoice.awaiting(a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending()),
                "Installed source preparation failure preserves an explicit retry choice");
        a.failPrepare = false; a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.resumed = false; a.drainPendingSetup(); a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 0,
                "Failed installed source preparation never retries during rendering or resume");
        click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 2 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "Explicit installed APK retry reuses the selected package after preparation failure");

        a = installed(); a.failInspect = true; click(a);
        require(a.installedInspections == 1 && a.prepares == 0
                        && a.setupSession.modeChoice.awaiting(a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending()),
                "Missing installed source remains retryable without preparing another game");
        a.failInspect = false; a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.installedInspections == 1, "Installed source inspection failure cannot auto-retry");
        click(a);
        require(a.installedInspections == 2 && a.prepares == 1 && a.chooserLaunches == 1,
                "Explicit retry can recover installed source inspection");

        a = installed(); GameModeChoice.Request<Uri> canceled = a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending();
        a.actions.perform(SharedGameSelectionControl.CANCEL_ACCESS_SELECTION);
        require(a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending() == null, "Cancel clears the pending installed source choice");
        a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        a.dispatchInlineAccess(canceled, GameModeChoice.Mode.APK);
        require(a.installedInspections == 0 && a.bridgeChecks == 0 && a.prepares == 0 && a.chooserLaunches == 0,
                "Canceled installed source cannot start through a stale choice or lifecycle replay");

        a = installed(); a.deferNextWork = true; click(a); a.setupSession.modeChoice.discard();
        a.finishDeferredWork(); a.renderDiscovery(); a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.installedInspections == 1 && a.bridgeChecks == 0 && a.prepares == 0 && a.chooserLaunches == 0,
                "Invalidated installed choice cannot continue after deferred source inspection");

        for (int gate = 0; gate < 6; gate++) {
            a = installed();
            if (gate == 0) a.resumed = false;
            if (gate == 1) a.destroyed = true;
            if (gate == 2) a.setupSession.owner = new MainActivity();
            if (gate == 3) a.busy = true;
            if (gate == 4) a.recovery = true;
            if (gate == 5) a.page = SyncPage.HOME;
            click(a);
            require(a.installedInspections == 0 && a.prepares == 0 && a.chooserLaunches == 0,
                    "Inactive installed APK action gate " + gate);
        }
        System.out.println("installed APK action integration passed");
    }
    static void click(MainActivity a) { a.actions.perform(SharedGameSelectionControl.SWITCH_TO_EMBEDDED); }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        MainActivity noticeOwner = selected(); noticeOwner.feedbackError = true;
        for (PreparationDiagnostics.Stage stage : PreparationDiagnostics.Stage.values()) {
            PreparationDiagnostics.Failure failure = new PreparationDiagnostics.Failure(stage,
                    new IOException("/data/private/secret.apk https://example.invalid/?password=secret"), null);
            String safe = failure.userMessage(); noticeOwner.notice = safe;
            require(noticeOwner.visibleNotice().equals(safe), "Preserve fixed safe preparation message " + stage);
            require(!safe.contains("secret"), "No cause detail in visible message");
            noticeOwner.notice = safe + " /data/private/secret.apk";
            require(noticeOwner.visibleNotice().equals("操作未完成，请重试。"), "Reject appended details");
        }
        for (String unsafe : List.of("/data/private/secret.apk", "准备未完成：secret", "PREP_LOCAL_KEY secret")) {
            noticeOwner.notice = unsafe;
            require(noticeOwner.visibleNotice().equals("操作未完成，请重试。"), "Untrusted text still goes through NoviceCopy");
        }
        MainActivity a = selected(); List<Uri> exact = a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending().source.apks;
        click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.processed == exact, "APK card must process exact selected base/splits immediately");
        require(a.prepared.gameApks.size() == 2 && a.installer.installs == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 1,
                "Split APK preparation must reach system installer IntentSender");
        require(a.bridgeChecks == 0 && a.rootCalls == 0, "No installed bridge or Root substitution");
        click(a); require(a.prepares == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 1, "Active install double tap must not repeat");
        a.openInstallConfirmation(); require(a.intentLaunches == 1, "Confirmation nonce prevents duplicate launch");

        a = selected(); SharedGameSelectionActions stale = a.actions; a.renderDiscovery();
        stale.perform(SharedGameSelectionControl.SWITCH_TO_EMBEDDED);
        require(a.prepares == 0, "Stale Compose callback cannot dispatch");
        click(a); require(a.intentLaunches == 1, "Current Compose callback still works");
        a = selected(); a.setupSession.accessMode = GameModeChoice.Mode.APK;
        a.setupSession.selectedSource = a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending().source;
        a.setupSession.modeChoice.discard(); click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 1, "Explicit APK choice must not be inert when already in APK mode");

        a = selected(); a.pauseAfterPrepare = true; click(a);
        require(a.prepares == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 0 && a.setupSession.installationAdvancePending, "Background completion must defer system UI");
        a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup(); require(a.intentLaunches == 1, "Foreground resumes installation");

        a = selected(); a.strategy = GamePreparationService.InstallStrategy.REQUIRES_UNINSTALL; click(a);
        require(a.confirmation != null && a.confirmationText.contains("签名不同") && a.confirmationText.contains("丢失已有存档"), "Signing conflict and data-loss warning visible");
        require(a.installer.uninstalls == 0 && a.intentLaunches == 0, "Never uninstall automatically");
        a.setupSession.flow.select("different.game"); a.confirmation.run();
        require(a.installer.uninstalls == 0, "Stale uninstall approval cannot affect another target");

        a = selected(); a.strategy = GamePreparationService.InstallStrategy.REQUIRES_UNINSTALL; click(a); a.confirmation.run();
        require(a.installer.uninstalls == 1, "Only explicit current-target confirmation requests uninstall");
        a = selected(); a.allowInstalls = false; click(a);
        require(a.settingsLaunches == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 0, "Missing unknown-source permission opens settings");
        a.allowInstalls = true; a.continueInstallation(); require(a.intentLaunches == 1, "Permission return resumes install");

        for (int gate = 0; gate < 6; gate++) {
            a = selected();
            if (gate == 0) a.resumed = false;
            if (gate == 1) a.destroyed = true;
            if (gate == 2) a.setupSession.owner = new MainActivity();
            if (gate == 3) a.busy = true;
            if (gate == 4) a.recovery = true;
            if (gate == 5) a.page = SyncPage.HOME;
            click(a); require(a.prepares == 0, "Inactive action gate " + gate);
        }
        a = selected(); a.failPrepare = true; click(a);
        require(a.feedbackError && a.setupSession.modeChoice.awaiting(a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending()), "Failed preparation remains retryable");
        a.failPrepare = false; click(a); require(a.prepares == 2 && a.intentLaunches == 1, "Retry selected source");

        a = selected(); final MainActivity owner = a;
        GameModeChoice.Request<Uri> request = a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending();
        android.app.AlertDialog dialog = GameModeChoiceDialog.show(a, a.setupSession.modeChoice, request, () -> owner.resumed,
                new GameModeChoice.Actions<Uri>() {
                    public void root(GameModeChoice.Request<Uri> r) { owner.resolveRootSetupSource(r); }
                    public void apk(GameModeChoice.Request<Uri> r) { owner.chooseApkSetupSource(r); }
                }, () -> {}, null);
        dialog.click("修改 APK"); require(a.prepares == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 1, "Legacy real dialog listener also reaches installation");
        a = selected(); a.failLaunch = true; click(a);
        require(a.feedbackError && a.openedConfirmationNonce.isEmpty() && a.installer.launched == 0,
                "Failed launch rolls back both confirmation guards");
        a.failLaunch = false; a.openInstallConfirmation();
        require(a.intentLaunches == 0, "Failed automatic launch cannot replay itself");
        a.retryInstallConfirmation();
        require(a.intentLaunches == 1 && a.installer.installs == 1, "Retry reuses session, not another install");
        a.setupSession.confirmationLaunchAttemptAt = -10000;
        a.retryInstallConfirmation();
        require(a.intentLaunches == 2 && a.installer.installs == 1, "Explicit retry reopens same retained confirmation");
        a.retryInstallConfirmation();
        require(a.intentLaunches == 2, "Repeated immediate retry is throttled");
        a.setupSession.confirmationLaunchAttemptAt = -10000; a.systemReturnPending = true;
        a.retryInstallConfirmation();
        require(a.intentLaunches == 2, "Returned system flow cannot be replayed");

        for (boolean systemDisabled : List.of(false, true)) {
            for (boolean ownInstallPermission : List.of(false, true)) {
                a = selectedSingle(); a.disabledSystemInstaller = systemDisabled; a.allowInstalls = ownInstallPermission;
                a.strategy = GamePreparationService.InstallStrategy.REQUIRES_UNINSTALL;
                List<Uri> singleSource = a.setupSession.modeChoice.pending().source.apks;
                click(a);
                require(a.chooserLaunches == 1 && a.installer.externalPrepares == 1,
                        "Single APK uses default ACTION_VIEW regardless of system installer enablement");
                require(a.prepared.gameApks.size() == 1 && a.processed == singleSource,
                        "Ordinary handoff preserves the explicit selected single APK");
                require(a.installer.installs == 0 && a.installer.uninstalls == 0 && a.intentLaunches == 0 && a.settingsLaunches == 0,
                        "Single APK bypasses own session, automatic uninstall and own-source settings");
                require(a.confirmation == null && a.installer.external,
                        "New single APK directly opens default installer without a switch prompt");
            }
        }

        a = selectedSingle(); a.specialHelperInput = true; click(a);
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 0 && a.installer.installs == 1 && a.intentLaunches == 1,
                "Special helper input does not use ordinary single-game APK handoff");

        a = selectedSingle(); a.pauseAfterPrepare = true; click(a);
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 0 && a.installer.externalPrepares == 0,
                "Background preparation cannot open default installer");
        a.resumed = true; a.drainPendingSetup();
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 1 && a.installer.installs == 0, "Foreground continuation uses default external installer");

        a = selectedSingle(); click(a);
        // Model a restored older own-session request for a single APK, before explicit switching.
        a.installer.external = false; a.installer.active = a.installer.confirmation = true;
        a.installer.installs = 1; a.installer.externalPrepares = 0; a.chooserLaunches = 0;
        a.actions.perform(SharedGameSelectionControl.USE_OTHER_INSTALLER);
        require(a.confirmation != null && a.installer.externalPrepares == 0,
                "Existing own session requires explicit switch confirmation");
        a.confirmation.run();
        require(a.chooserLaunches == 1 && a.installer.externalPrepares == 1 && a.installer.installs == 1,
                "Approved manual switch opens default installer without another own install");

        a = selectedSingle(); a.failChooser = true; click(a);
        require(a.feedbackError && a.installer.externalEnds == 1 && !a.installer.external,
                "Default installer launch failure explicitly cleans up external wait and sharing");
        verifyInstalledApkActions();
        System.out.println("selected APK action integration passed");
    }
}
